alibabacloud-cdn-traffic-anomaly 0.0.1 – Initial release

- Provides read-only diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud CDN traffic and bandwidth anomalies.
- Identifies abnormal time windows via usage data (bps/flow/QPS) baseline and peak comparison.
- Analyzes CDN offline access logs with four-dimension Top statistics, 13 theft rules, and T1~T6 classification.
- Outputs structured, evidence-based reports without ever modifying CDN configuration.
- Enforces strict prohibitions against mutating actions or handling credentials directly.
- Requires only the aliyun CLI and Python 3.9+, with automatic credential and UID derivation.
